name: Word Squares
author: Addicting Games
description: Word Squares is a free puzzle game. The pictures tell you everything you need to know, you just need to figure it out. Word Squares is a puzzle game that puts you in the hot seat. As the timer ticks down you'll have to decipher the message, unscramble the letters and find the word. In Word Squares, the word is king, the word is the goal, and the word is fun. This is a unique puzzle game that confronts you with four pictures that hint at what the word might be. You have a limited amount of time to find the theme, see the pattern, put it all together, and unlock the level. This game takes crosswords to the next level and lets you stretch your investigative muscles. If you consider yourself a word nerd or a letter slinger, then this is the kind of game that you'll want to use to challenge your friends or devastate your enemies. Compete to place the highest on our leaderboard and prove that you are the ultimate word-knowing person. Some people just say words, but true Word nerds can pull them out of the ether and use them to score big.
